s0033: Read position, velocity and tilt to choose a force.
s0044: BAM drive · voltage, torque and wheel state
s0045: Radius, width and inertia come from the ROBOTIS wheel URDF. Hub/tread appearance is reconstructed, not the original STL. Mounting compatibility is unverified.
s0054: Training, inference and replay are different
s0055: Live computes new actions from current observations. A separate Worker collects experience and updates weights with PPO. Chapters 2–4 read recorded calculations; inspecting them does not train.
s0057: Reward costs define the task. Learning rate and clipping define how the network learns. Mass, motors and disturbances define where it learns. Apply conditions to the test only, continue existing weights, or create a new random learner.
s0059: The Actor 5→16→2 outputs left/right probabilities. The Critic 5→16→1 predicts discounted future reward. Collect 16 environments×128 steps, then train for 4 epochs with minibatches of 128. No backpropagation through physics or the fixed Advantage.
s0060: Reward, Advantage and loss are different. GAE targets are estimates, not known future outcomes. PPO clipping is not a probability or performance guarantee. This engine reports KL but does not use KL early stopping.
s0062: Identified BAM M6 parameters and electrical torque/friction equations are ported to JavaScript. This is not Python BAM or MuJoCo running in the browser. A local stall-force-to-voltage adapter replaces firmware position control; communication and thermal protection are not modeled.
s0063: The model is planar and no-slip: policy 50 Hz, physics 200 Hz. It includes reflected wheel/rotor inertia and checks traction against the normal load including pole vertical acceleration. Exceeding the constraint stops at a model-validity limit; post-slip motion is not invented.
s0064: Wheel dimensions and inertia come from ROBOTIS URDF; appearance is reconstructed. Original STL fidelity, tire slip, body pitch/yaw, battery/thermal/current protection and physical mounting are unverified. This is an educational viewer, not a deployable hardware controller.
s0066: Force magnitude alone is not enough: duration, onset, direction and initial state matter. A 12 N button is a test, not training. Failure before the pulse is not a recovery test. Exported trials include pulse exposure, actual impulse and failure reason.
s0068: Choose fixed conditions, an intensity ramp or success-gated stages. Curriculum-gate seeds and held-out evaluation seeds are separate. OOD increases selected factors 1.5×; it does not represent every unseen condition. Save a checkpoint before refreshing. Language changes never alter training state.
s0069: This release uses physics/checkpoint version 2. Open earlier checkpoints in the archived Korean viewer; do not silently resume across different physics.
cost.position.help: Penalize goal error. Changing the reward requires new experience, not just another test.
cost.velocity.help: Penalize squared cart speed; a larger cost can trade off fast recovery.
cost.angle.help: Penalize squared normalized tilt. Larger is not automatically better.
probe.legend: Pass requires both survival and tracking. Model-invalid stops are not simulated slips. A trial that ends before t = 3 s never tests the manual pulse. Export includes requested and actually delivered impulse, failure cause and recorded recovery time.
active.notice: Muted ranges are inactive for this profile. They are retained as a draft, not secretly used in the test or training.

scenario.read: Same observation, fixed weights → inference. New weights from experience → learning.
